author: Inside Edition
description: Danny Stewart and Peter Mercurio share how they found a baby in a New York subway station, and later adopted him. In 2000, the pair were planning to meet for a dinner date, and Danny saw small legs sticking out of a sweatshirt on the floor while walking through a downtown Manhattan subway station. After calling 911 for help, Peter met up with him. "You're going to be connected to this baby for the rest of your life," he told Danny. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Couple Adopts Baby After Finding It In A NYC Subway Station
